notes.title: I'm really sorry I wasn't able to meet your expectations.
notes.notes:
The game’s network functionality did not perform as intended, 
and I deeply regret that I could not address all the bugs that caused players to lose valuable time. 
I am truly sorry for the inconvenience this has caused.

I will do my best to improve the game's current state and carefully review the gameplay. 
Given the unpredictable nature of network environments, 
I plan to shift focus from intense competitive gameplay to more casual and enjoyable experiences. 
I will continue to provide updates on new gameplay features and improvements.
This will take some time, but I promise I won't give up on this game.

Once again, I apologize to all the players who have been affected and who were looking forward to this game. I am committed to making the game better moving forward.

notes.title: Network update
notes.notes:
I am very sorry for the issues currently happening in the game.
